issues.description: The UML in problem_statement.md indicates Ride attributes are private (shown with '-' in the UML). In the solution, Ride.name is declared public (public String name;), while abbreviation is private. This visibility mismatch deviates from the UML/specification and can confuse students about expected attribute visibility and encapsulation (the exercise instructs to add public getters for all attributes, which implies attributes should be non-public).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Ride.name attribute private (private String name;) so it matches the UML visibility and encapsulation expectations, and keep or provide a public getter getName(). Ensure all attributes follow the UML visibility (private) and are accessed via public getters as required by the exercise.
